checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Main subject is recognisably the supplied fox mascot
must.why: Fox matches the original closely in face, hoodie, jeans, boots and tail.

must.item: Fox retains orange hoodie and friendly appearance
must.why: Orange hoodie with pocket and drawstrings, smiling face kept.

must.item: Full body including ears and feet visible
must.why: Ears at the top and both feet at the bottom are fully in frame.

must.item: Pink and teal gradients and retro vaporwave treatment connect to style-ref
must.why: Pink-to-teal sky, neon grid floor and a partly hidden striped sun are present.

must.item: One square image with no added text
must.why: No text is present, but the output is a portrait poster with a white border and drop shadow, not a square image.

faults.what: The output is not square. It copies the poster's white border, paper edge and drop shadow, so it looks like a photo of a poster.
The striped sun is mostly hidden behind the fox's head and shoulders, so it reads as odd stripes behind the neck.
The fox is flat vector art with a black outline on a synthwave background, so the styles do not fully blend. It has no glow or lighting integration.
The poster's speckle marks remain on the background.

summary: The fox is faithfully preserved, full body, on a pink-teal synthwave grid poster with no text, but the output is a bordered portrait poster rather than a square image and the sun is mostly hidden behind the fox.
